title: Self-Inverse S-box for DEFAULT-LAYER
summary: DEFAULT-LAYER fixes cryptographic criteria for its S-box, while constructing a self-inverse choice that meets them remains open.

formal_statement.body: Construct an S-box $S$ satisfying the DEFAULT-LAYER criteria such that $S^{-1}=S$.

scope.domain: Design of a self-inverse S-box for DEFAULT-LAYER.
parameters: S: the target S-box constrained to be its own inverse
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a self-inverse S-box satisfying the DEFAULT-LAYER criteria.

citations.label: DEFAULT: Cipher Level Resistance Against Differential Fault Attack

progress.summary: The paper presents this in an explicit list of potential open problems, suggesting a search for a self-inverse S-box that fits its criteria. The stated motivation is lower hardware cost when the layer and its inverse share a circuit.
citation_labels: Anubhab Baksi et al., DEFAULT: Cipher Level Resistance Against Differential Fault Attack
